title: The Twins Start a Group Chat
skyStory: Sixteen percent lit and climbing, the moon has bounded into Gemini, the twins, the sign that talks with both hands and texts with both thumbs. The sky is suddenly very chatty. Gemini has started a group chat with every star and named it Spring Plans. Saturn has muted it. Mars replied with forty-two messages in a row.

reading: Words are your instrument, Life Path 3, and Gemini just tuned every string. Messages flow easily today, maybe too easily. Before sending anything over four paragraphs, read it once out loud to the cabin walls.

Around 1:30 pm a conversation will veer off into a delightful tangent, something about birds or old cartoons or why spoons exist. Follow it for five minutes. The best ideas this week live in that tangent. The [[Page of Swords]] is lurking nearby with a notebook, writing down every clever thing you say. Ask it for a copy later.
joel.mission: Start a conversation with a question you have never asked anyone before, and listen to the whole answer.
joel.omen: Two birds chattering on a wire. It means a conversation today matters more than it seems, so pay attention.

reading: Your hands are going to be busy today. Gemini loves a storyteller, and you are about to be cast as the lead in at least three conversations before dinner.

One of them will be with someone who needs a push to level up. Do your thing: one well-aimed question, one story about a time you got unstuck, and a wink. The Wood Rat clocks the exact moment their eyes light up. Later, around 8 pm, write down the best sentence you said all day. Gemini insists it was very good, and Gemini is rarely wrong about sentences.
nancy.mission: Teach someone one small trick or shortcut you know, even if it seems too obvious to share.
nancy.omen: A notebook or scrap of paper left behind on a table. It means your words are needed, so write something.

together.text: Text each other only in questions for one full hour this evening. No statements allowed. The first one to accidentally say something that is not a question owes the other a ridiculous nickname for the weekend. Gemini is moderating and has already taken sides.

game.intro: The Twins started a group chat. Answer the way they would: emoji only, zero letters, max drama.
game.prompt: A movie or show about two of something: twins, best friends, a pair of very odd ducks.
